title: Effects of physical exercise on cognitive impairment in patients with Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease or mild cognitive impairment: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: Data analysis was performed on the cognitive outcome measures of the RCTs.
adjudication.k_quote: In total, 28 RCTs were eligible for inclusion in this review (AD n = 8; MCI n = 16; PD n = 4).
adjudication.reason: RCT-only MA; the review includes 28 RCTs (3 were only dropped from the analysis for missing data), so k=28 > 25.
